_source: Extracted from dubizzle-facelift/horizontal .cssm files. Verify with scripts/sync-tokens.mjs after a monorepo update.
_rootFontSizeNote: 1rem = 10px throughout the codebase. Every rem value below reads as its px value x10.
_breakpointNote: 768px is the real desktop/mobile split — 182 of the facelift media queries key off it. Treat `max-width: 768px` as 'mobile' and `min-width: 768px` as 'desktop'.

container.formula: width: min(100% - 2 * gutter, maxWidth); margin-inline: auto;

desktop._note: Filter sidebar is a fixed 304px; results column takes the rest.

mobile.layout: single column, filters open in a full-screen sheet

list._note: On mobile the list item carries the white card background; on desktop the card itself does.

spacingScale._note: Upstream names are historical and inconsistent (`ternary` 2.5rem and `tertiary` 1.2rem are different tokens). Prefer the --space-N semantic scale for new work.

zIndex._note: Header is sticky at z-index 6; dropdowns and dialogs sit above it. See --*-z-index tokens for the full set.
